dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and continuous 2D narrowing from the widest mid-section toward a high-frequency acute point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth and linear lateral margins; the anterior-left margin is partially obscured by localized water surface turbulence and foam.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity uniform reflectance across the entire visible dorsal plane.
